comparisons.peer_topic: Gross margin financial results and VMware impact
comparisons.peer_summary: Gross margin increased to $32,509 million in fiscal year 2024 from $24,690 million in fiscal year 2023, primarily due to VMware contributions offset by higher amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets. As a percentage of net revenue, gross margin decreased to 63% from 69%, driven by the same amortization factors, less favorable semiconductor product mix, and offsets from infrastructure software margins.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Broadcom report on their 2024 gross margin percentage changes, but they experienced opposite directional movements with different primary drivers. AMD's gross margin increased to 49% from 46%, driven by a favorable shift in revenue mix towards higher Data Center and Client revenues. In contrast, Broadcom's gross margin decreased to 63% from 69%, primarily due to higher amortization of acquisition-related intangible assets from the VMware Merger, less favorable semiconductor product mix, and infrastructure software margin offsets, despite an increase in total gross margin dollars from VMware contributions.
